```{r}
# DUO/inspectorate: advice_reconsiderations, test_scores, main_provider,
# final_advice, reference_levels, school_weighting.
# Reports: cvte_conditional, cvte_provisional, cvte_pupils, cvte_agreement,

```

```{r}
#| label: data-columns
datasets <- c(
    "advice_reconsiderations", "test_scores", "main_provider", "final_advice",
    "reference_levels", "school_weighting", "cvte_conditional",
    "cvte_provisional", "cvte_pupils", "cvte_agreement",
    "cito_misclassification", "gap_matrix", "source_checks"
)
describe <- function(x) {
    x <- as.data.frame(get(x))
    types <- vapply(x, pillar::type_sum, "")
    paste0(names(x), " (", types, ")", collapse = ", ")
}
knitr::kable(data.frame(
    data = datasets,
    rows = vapply(datasets, \(x) NROW(get(x)), 0),
    columns = vapply(datasets, describe, "")
), row.names = FALSE, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```
